subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): reject oversized apply body files

question: Should `wiki apply synthesis --body-file` adopt a hard 1 MiB public input limit, or should the memory-wiki implementation address buffering without rejecting existing larger body files?
rationale: The PR resolves a resource concern by introducing a new externally visible CLI restriction; repository policy treats new fail-closed behavior and removed fallbacks as compatibility-sensitive decisions.

options.title: Preserve current input compatibility
options.body: Rework the read/mutation path so larger existing body files remain supported while resource handling is made safe.

options.title: Approve a 1 MiB contract
options.body: Accept the limit as intentional, document it, provide upgrade rationale, and prove valid and rejected CLI behavior in a real vault.

recommendation.title: Preserve current input compatibility
recommendation.body: Rework the read/mutation path so larger existing body files remain supported while resource handling is made safe.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion explicitly mentions steipete and the unresolved question is product and compatibility direction rather than a mechanical test repair.
